item.title: Web3Auth Flaw Exploited to Steal Keplr Crypto, Provider Empties Other Wallets for Safety
item.description: Some people who set up a Keplr crypto wallet with their Google or Apple account have had money stolen by an attacker. Web3Auth then used the attacker's own route to empty other at-risk wallets before the attacker…
